verdict.rationale: Downloadable API specs are a fair question for a backend platform like Firebase, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The MCP server and CLI are separate capabilities and do not count as a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
